reason: The sky is clearing, so brushing dust off the array seems like a practical first step toward restoring power for essential services.
expectation: I expect the cleaned array to produce more power, though it may take further steps to restart the services.

alternatives.reason: Restoring the water line also seems relevant, but the earlier storm response said the pipe needs thaw checks before reopening.

effect: The cleaned array now provides a restored solar supply, making it possible to reconnect the discovery case.
reaction: It is satisfying to have solar power available again, though the result gives little detail.
reason: The case needs continuous refrigeration, so reconnecting it to the restored supply seems useful while essential services restart.
expectation: I expect the case refrigerator to run from solar power again, though the changeover may require further action.

alternatives.reason: Restoring the water line also matters, but the case contains the frozen discovery and already has an offered power connection.

effect: The discovery case is now on station power, so I can turn to restoring the water line and moving the plants.
reaction: The power changeover was reassuring, though the result was brief.
reason: The water line is part of the essential services that need restarting, and the menu offers a compatible way to refill it.
expectation: I expect water service to be restored, though I am unsure how the earlier thaw checks are handled.

alternatives.reason: Moving the lettuce back toward daylight also seems useful, but restoring water is my priority.

effect: The line is primed and water has reached the tap; the remaining goal is to return both troughs to the window.
reaction: It is reassuring to see water service restored, though the result does not explain the earlier thaw checks.
reason: The lettuce trough needs to return to the window, and placing it on the shelf directly advances that goal.
expectation: I expect the lettuce trough to be placed at the window; the potato trough will still need to be moved.

alternatives.reason: The potato trough also needs to return, and either seems a reasonable first move.

effect: The lettuce trough is at the window shelf; the potato trough still needs to be returned.
reaction: The placement was straightforward, with no further detail.
reason: The potato trough is the remaining trough to move, and this is the only gameplay action offered.
expectation: I expect the potato trough to be placed at the window shelf, completing the stated goal.

effect: Both troughs are back at the window, completing the chapter.
reaction: The final placement was straightforward and gave a quiet sense of recovery after the storm.

mostWorthwhile.text: Restoring water to the cabin tap was the most worthwhile moment: the pump clearing air from the line gave a concrete picture of the restart.

leastWorthwhile.text: Moving the two troughs was clear but repetitive; neither placement added much detail.

surprise.text: The water-line result showed that the pump first had to push air out before water reached the tap.

arbitrary.text: Refilling the line had a clear purpose, but I was unsure how the earlier thaw checks had been handled.

continue.text: I would continue to learn what happens to the body in the ice and how it reaches Earth; reconnecting its case kept that question present.
